name: Opportunity
summary: A solar-powered rover planned for 90 days that worked for nearly 14 years and found evidence that water once shaped its landing region.
discoveries: Evidence that liquid water once existed at Meridiani Planum

stories.kids: I was built for a 90-day job and kept going for almost 14 years. A giant dust storm blocked the sunlight I needed, and I went quiet.
stories.explorer: Opportunity landed in January 2004 and explored Meridiani Planum, studying rocks that recorded a wetter Martian past. A global dust storm in 2018 cut off its solar power.
stories.scientist: Opportunity operated at Meridiani Planum from 2004 to 2018. Last contact was June 10, 2018, during a planet-encircling dust storm that limited solar power.
